tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Opens a coding project in VS Code by path. Use when the user says 'open [project name]'. The system prompt contains a list of known projects with their paths.

path.description: The absolute path to the project folder (e.g., '/Users/sebastian/code/ParaDict2')

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Opens a macOS application by name

tools.name: open_url
tools.description: Opens a URL in the default browser

tools.name: run_shell
tools.description: Runs a shell command. Use sparingly and only for safe operations.

tools.name: set_audio_output
tools.description: Switches the system audio output to a different device. Use when the user says things like 'switch to speakers', 'use the A125', 'change audio to headphones', 'output to [device name]'.

device_name.description: The name or partial name of the audio output device (e.g., 'speakers', 'MacBook Pro Speakers', 'A-125', 'headphones')

tools.name: list_audio_outputs
tools.description: Lists all available audio output devices. Use when the user asks 'what audio devices do I have', 'show me the speakers', 'list audio outputs'.
